introduction: Delaware residents who qualify for federal EITC can claim a state earned income tax credit. Choose the applicable option using the filing year’s instructions.
description: Delaware residents who qualify for federal EITC can claim a state earned income tax credit. Choose the applicable option using the filing year’s instructions.

sections.who: Federal EITC eligibility and Delaware resident-return rules apply. Filing status and how spouses file can affect the calculation.
sections.get: For tax year 2025, resident instructions offer a refundable credit equal to 4.5% of federal EITC or a nonrefundable 20% option. Compare the result; do not add both.
sections.docs:
• The completed federal return and federal EITC amount.
  • Wage and self-employment records.
  • The matching Delaware resident return and required credit schedule.
sections.apply:
1. Select the correct year

    Use Delaware personal income-tax forms.

  2. Compare credit options

    Follow the resident instructions. A refundable-credit claim requires PIT-CRS.

  3. File and keep the calculation

    Submit the required schedule with the return and retain your worksheets.
sections.after: These stated percentages refer to 2025. Recheck instructions for another year and respond to any revenue-department notice.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using 2025 resident return instructions; Delaware tax forms. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.
